bio.text: Riley Owen is the Republican candidate for Utah's 1st Congressional District in 2026 and lives in Salt Lake City.
He studied at Princeton University and earned a master's degree in public policy at the University of Oxford.
He worked as a policy analyst at the White House during President Trump's first administration and serves as an intelligence officer in the U.S. Navy Reserve.
